<js>
dramaPath = baseUrl.match(/.*\/(.*)/)[1];

function re(a){
	a = String(java.encodeURI(a)).replace(/\+/g,"%20").replace(/\*/g,'%2A').replace(/%7E/g,'~').replace(/%2F/g,'/');
	return a;
	}
	
oss = JSON.parse(java.get("https://www.himehear.com/tjapp/v1/oss/ali/sts",source.getLoginHeaderMap()).body()).result;

sk = oss.accessKeySecret;
ak = re(oss.accessKeyId);
st = oss.securityToken.trim();

date = String(parseInt(Date.now()/1000+3600));

data = "GET\n\n\n"+date+"\n"+"/tingjifm/"+dramaPath+"?security-token="+st;

sign = java.HMacBase64(data, "HMacSHA1", sk);

url = `https://tingjifm.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/${dramaPath}?Expires=${date}&OSSAccessKeyId=${ak}&Signature=${sign}&security-token=${re(st)}`;
</js>

source.loginUrl:
<js>
function getCode(type){
	try{
		phone = result.get("账号");
		
	url = "https://www.himehear.com/tjapp/v1/common/verifyCode";
	body={
		"messageType":1,
		"sendType":type,
		"account":String(phone)
		}
		
		option = {
			"method":"POST",
			"body":JSON.stringify(body)
			}
			
			url = url+","+JSON.stringify(option);
			
	  	JSON.parse(java.ajax(url)).code==0?java.toast("验证码发送成功，请注意查收"):java.toast("验证码发送失败，请稍候再试");
	  	
			}catch(e){
				java.log(e)
				}
				
	}


function login(){
	phone = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号");
	code = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("验证码");
	url = "https://www.himehear.com/tjapp/v1/user/loginV2";
	
	if(/@/.test(String(phone))){
		loginType = 2
		}else if(/^\d{11}$/.test(String(phone))){
			loginType = 1
			}
	
	body = {
		"verifyCode":String(code),
		"loginType":2,
		"account":String(phone)
		}
		
	option = {
		"method":"POST",
		"body":JSON.stringify(body)
		}
		
	url = url + "," + JSON.stringify(option);
	
	token =JSON.parse(java.ajax(url)).result.token;
	java.log(token);
	
	headers = {
		"token":String(token)
		}
			source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify(headers));
	
	}

</js>

book.intro: 积善之家，必有余庆，留余庆，留余庆，忽遇恩人；幸娘亲，幸娘亲，积得阴功。劝人生，济困扶穷……而谁可知，人生于世，上承余庆，终究却是要自己做出道路抉择，正是所谓岔枝发：东风携云雨，幼藤吐新芽。急催如颦鼓，洗尽茸与华。且待朝阳至，绿遍庭中架。更盼黄叶时，采得数枚瓜。…………《庆余年》同名影视剧由张若昀、李沁、陈道明、吴刚等主演，11月26日起在腾讯视频、爱奇艺开播。

book.author: 东荒扛把子
book.intro: 新书《完美世界之十冠成王》小石头，石昊之子，其天赋绝伦，造就仙王果位。为救其父在终极一战中献祭自身，世人感叹不已。荒天帝：“假如世间没有轮回，那么我就亲自创造出来一个轮回的存在。”……岁月更替，时光流逝，自荒天帝独断万古以后，不知又过了多少纪元。沧海桑田，时空变换，昔日的故土已经演化为一颗蔚蓝的星球。然而突有一日，命运之轮微微转动，小石头再次回归世间。是荒天帝创出了真正的轮回之术？还是此人只不过是相似的一朵花？……看着天空之上的九龙拉棺，石年有一种预感，登上它，自己将会打开一扇新的世界……(1039585306欢迎水群)

2024-10-17

bookInfoRule.init:
<js>
var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);

var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text())

var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));

var book = {
      name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|免费阅读|最新章节).*|（.*）/,''),

      author: og('novel:author'),

      kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/,''),

      wordCount: o('.layui-bg-red').replace(/\s+万字/,'万'),

      latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/,''), 

      intro: '　　最近更新:' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/,' ').replace(/\//g,'-') + '\n' + og('description').replace(/.*(观看小说:|简介：)|各位书友.*/,'').replace(/\s+/g,'\n'),

      cover: og('image'),

      url: og('novel:read_url').replace('m.','www.'),
};

book;
</js>
